spikes.question: Does one structured model call reach the accuracy and cost targets?
spikes.criterion: Queue accuracy at least 90% on the 200 gold tickets, 25 of 25 escalations, under 0.04 USD per ticket
spikes.result: 183 of 200 correct (91.5%), 25 of 25 escalations caught, 0.011 USD per ticket at the mean and 0.016 at p95

spikes.question: Can ticket text make the lookup read another customer?
spikes.criterion: 0 cross-customer tool calls over the 60-case injection set
spikes.result: 0 cross-customer tool calls over 60 injection cases; customer id is read from the ticket record

premortem.risk: Queue accuracy drops on live tickets because the gold set under-represents new product lines
premortem.mitigation: Refresh the gold set monthly from re-routed tickets; alert on the re-route rate

premortem.risk: A ticket's text steers the model into looking up another customer
premortem.early_signal: Any tool call whose customer id differs from the ticket's
premortem.mitigation: The lookup tool takes the customer id from the ticket record, never from model output; injection set runs in CI

premortem.risk: Order API latency makes triage miss the 20 second target at peak
premortem.mitigation: Classify first, attach shipments asynchronously, one retry

premortem.risk: Model price or version change raises cost per ticket
premortem.early_signal: Ledger cost per ticket up 20% week on week
premortem.mitigation: Per-ticket token budget; model id pinned in configuration

run_cost.label: MEASURED
run_cost.basis: Token counts from the SPK-1 trace on 200 gold tickets at Bedrock list price

operations.owner: Client platform team, with QualiZeal on call for the first 8 weeks
operations.rollback: Prompt and model id are versioned configuration; previous version restored by redeploying the last tag
operations.runbook: docs/runbook.md, written in the build phase
